name: The World Ending
overview: Scripture teaches that the timing of the world’s end and Christ’s return is known only by the Father, emphasizing the need for constant vigilance and readiness (Matthew 24:36, 42, 44). Believers are called to watch and pray continually so they may be found worthy to stand before the Son of Man at His coming (Luke 21:36). Endurance until the end is essential for salvation, highlighting the perseverance required in the Christian walk amid the uncertainties of the last days (Matthew 24:13). The disciples’ inquiry about the signs of the end underscores the importance of understanding these events within God’s sovereign plan (Matthew 24:3).
